heroHeadline: Drone Strike Kills 11 in North Kordofan Market; RSF Hits Omdurman, Damazin, and Abu Jubeiha in Coordinated Campaign
heroSubtitle: A drone struck the crowded main market in Abu Zaeima, North Kordofan, on June 6, 2026, killing at least 11 civilians and wounding dozens, according to Emergency Lawyers Sudan — while an RSF drone separately hit a fuel station in the SAF-held state capital El-Obeid the same day, wounding four. The day followed an RSF coordinated multi-state drone offensive on June 5 that simultaneously targeted SAF positions in Omdurman (Khartoum), Ed Damazin (Blue Nile capital), and Abu Jubeiha (Nuba Mountains, South Kordofan) — one of the broadest single-day RSF drone salvo operations of the war. SAF air defenses intercepted at least one strategic RSF drone over Omdurman; witnesses reported four powerful explosions. SAF continued its own drone strikes against RSF positions in North Kordofan on June 5, claiming heavy RSF losses in personnel and equipment, while intercepting a second RSF long-range drone over White Nile State that day. Day 1149 of the SAF-RSF war with no ceasefire and 28.9 million projected acutely hungry at the lean season peak (June–August 2026).
